reviewNotes: Twenty-five socializing, soil, resource, fishing, and weapon-interface strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, established tool and item names, neutral planting instructions, measurement wording, exact Galaxy Sword formatting, combat-stat terminology, punctuation, and natural Romanian interface phrasing; both found no remaining objective issue.

HoeDirt.cs.13919.translation: Plantarea este posibilă doar la fermă.

ResourceClump.cs.13945.source: Your axe isn't strong enough to break this stump.
ResourceClump.cs.13945.translation: Toporul tău nu este suficient de puternic pentru a distruge această buturugă.

ResourceClump.cs.13948.source: Your axe isn't strong enough to break this log.
ResourceClump.cs.13948.translation: Toporul tău nu este suficient de puternic pentru a distruge acest buștean.

ResourceClump.cs.13952.source: Your pickaxe isn't strong enough to break this.
ResourceClump.cs.13952.translation: Târnăcopul tău nu este suficient de puternic pentru a sparge asta.

ResourceClump.cs.13956.source: Your pickaxe isn't strong enough to break this boulder.
ResourceClump.cs.13956.translation: Târnăcopul tău nu este suficient de puternic pentru a sparge acest bolovan.

ResourceClump.cs.13962.source: Looks like you'll need an upgraded axe to destroy this gnarled old log.
ResourceClump.cs.13962.translation: Se pare că îți trebuie un topor îmbunătățit ca să distrugi acest buștean vechi și noduros.

ResourceClump.cs.13963.source: Looks like you'll need an upgraded pickaxe to destroy this dense stone.
ResourceClump.cs.13963.translation: Se pare că îți trebuie un târnăcop îmbunătățit ca să distrugi această piatră compactă.

ResourceClump.cs.13964.source: It looks pretty solid... maybe a very strong pickaxe could break it?
ResourceClump.cs.13964.translation: Pare foarte solidă... poate că un târnăcop foarte puternic ar putea s-o spargă?

Axe.cs.14023.source: You're only allowed to chop trees on your farm... It's a town rule.
Axe.cs.14023.translation: Ai voie să tai copaci doar la ferma ta... Este o regulă a orașului.

FishingRod.cs.14068.translation: Ai prins unul dintre peștii legendari.

FishingRod.cs.14085.translation: Ai folosit ultima bucată de momeală.

FishingRod.cs.14086.source: Your fishing tackle has worn out.
FishingRod.cs.14086.translation: Accesoriul tău de pescuit s-a uzat.

FishingRod.cs.14100.source: You found a lost book. The library has been expanded.
FishingRod.cs.14100.translation: Ai găsit o Carte pierdută. Colecția bibliotecii s-a mărit.
